trustBoundary: The Shell host supplies its verified live actor, Session, world and original game grant binding. Workshop rechecks that binding and reads its own durable latest confirmed turn before selecting a stage or any Canvas transaction identity. Caller JSON and this contract fixture do not authenticate a grant. An EXACT_REPLAY returns the stored outcome without another world write; a conflicting reuse is rejected. Every phase requires its current operation-specific grant scope. Only a durable Canvas VERIFIED Apply receipt may produce VERIFIED.
